title: Manual script sweep
description: Per-script regression: walk every Ask script through its golden path and edge cases on the iPhone webview, then on the AskMac native app. Each case isolates one script (disables others, enables only declared deps). Issues are pinned with kind + (x, y) location and the captured HTML for hand-off to a coding agent.

cases.title: Hello World · Web
cases.description: Walk every primary surface for Hello World on the iPhone webview. A simple Hello World demo script — exercises the bare minimum of the script chrome. Surfaces visited: home feed, script detail, tasks, settings.

steps.title: Cold open
steps.description: Open the home feed at /home with no other interaction; expect the script list to render.

steps.title: Tile / feed entry
steps.description: The hello-world tile or feed entry renders with its icon and name in the home feed.

steps.title: Tap into detail
steps.description: Navigate to /script/hello-world — the script's primary surface.

steps.title: Empty state
steps.description: Detail screen on first paint — what the user sees before data arrives.

steps.title: Populated state
steps.description: Same screen after a brief settle — captures whatever blocks the script publishes.

steps.title: Primary action
steps.description: Visit /tasks to confirm any tasks emitted by hello-world are in the feed.

steps.title: Error / refused state
steps.description: Visit /settings to confirm hello-world permissions and toggles render correctly.

steps.title: Back-out
steps.description: Return to the home feed; verify the tile state survives navigation.

cases.title: Hello World · AskMac
cases.description: Walk Settings ▸ Scripts ▸ Hello World on the AskMac native app. A simple Hello World demo script — exercises the bare minimum of the script chrome. Surfaces visited: scripts list, script row, permissions, blocks, logs.

steps.title: Cold open
steps.description: Open AskMac and confirm Settings ▸ Scripts shows hello-world as enabled.

steps.title: Script row
steps.description: The hello-world row shows the manifest version, summary, and an enable/disable toggle.

steps.title: Permissions sheet
steps.description: The script's declared permissions are listed correctly for hello-world.

steps.title: Block view
steps.description: If hello-world publishes blocks, they render in the AskMac viewer with no errors.

steps.title: Logs / errors pane
steps.description: Recent log lines for hello-world appear; no red error rows.

steps.title: Disable / re-enable
steps.description: Toggle hello-world off then on; verify clean teardown and re-installation.
